_meta.note: Captured off the wire: `opencode acp` 1.19.1 driven over stdio against a local Ollama model (llama3.2 3b, num_ctx 16384) reached through opencode's @ai-sdk/openai-compatible provider on a loopback endpoint, with a throwaway HOME and the project's `permission` set to ask. Agent-to-client lines in order, one short prompt. Covers five classes -- the initialize response with agentInfo.version, the session/new response with a sessionId, an agent_message_chunk turn, a usage_update, and the stopReason response. The tool-call and permission classes are live too, in tool-call-live.jsonl and permission-request-live.jsonl; see README.md beside this file. Reduced at capture through scripts/capture_acp_compaction.py's own reduce_frames: the product's redact_text scrub, the scratch working directory replaced with <cwd> and the home directory with ~, the session id replaced with the synthetic opencode-session-1 and message ids with msg-N, the available_commands_update inventory dropped, and each configOptions select cut to its current option. The capture's local model id and label are replaced with the synthetic local/model-1 and Local/model-1.
